summary: Make hub start after the network and NFS mounts: stop `pulpcore.service`, run `systemctl edit pulpcore.service` to add `[Unit] After=network.target var-lib-pulp.mount`, `systemctl enable remote-fs.target` and reboot. If pulp fails because token keys lack labels, run `chcon system_u:object_r:pulpcore_etc_t:s0 /etc/pulp/certs/token_{private,public}_key.pem` after each relabel.
questions: How do I make pulpcore start after NFS is mounted?
Pulp fails to start because of SELinux labels on token keys

answer_card.title: Start pulpcore after the NFS mount
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
systemctl stop pulpcore.service
systemctl edit pulpcore.service
#   [Unit]
#   After=network.target var-lib-pulp.mount
systemctl enable remote-fs.target
systemctl reboot
```
If pulp then fails on token keys:
```bash
chcon system_u:object_r:pulpcore_etc_t:s0 /etc/pulp/certs/token_{private,public}_key.pem
```
